slides.title: Spoken Tutorial on Creating your First API Key
slides.narration: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on **Creating your First API Key**.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to,


• Define what an **API key** is.
• Identify where to generate an **API key**.
• Apply steps to create an **API key**.
• Explain how to secure an **API key**.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration: Here I am using a browser on a computer or mobile.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration: To follow this tutorial, you should have completed **Episode 2: Intro to API**.

slides.title: What is an API Key?
slides.narration:
What is an **API key**?
It is a unique digital password.
It identifies you or your application.
You use it when interacting with an **API**.
Imagine it like an access card to a private club.
This key allows you entry and access to specific services.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration showing an API key as a digital access card

slides.title: Vague Approach: 'Just Get an API Key'
slides.narration:
Many people try a vague approach.
They simply search online for an **API key**.
This often leads to confusion.
Specific instructions are missing.
They do not know where to go or what to do.
slides.image_prompt: Person scratching head, confused at screen showing a vague online search for 'API key'

slides.title: Improved Approach: Creating a Key in Google AI Studio
slides.narration:
Let's look at an improved approach.
I will show you how to create your first **API key**.
First, go to **Google AI Studio**.
Sign in with your Google account.
Then, **click** 'Get API key'.
This creates a new key for you.
slides.image_prompt: Browser showing Google AI Studio interface, highlighting 'Get API key' button

slides.title: Comparing Approaches: Clarity vs. Confusion
slides.narration:
See the difference between the approaches?
The improved approach gives clear, actionable steps.
It removes the guesswork from a vague search.
This helps you generate your **API key** successfully.
You can do it efficiently.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side: screen showing vague search results vs. clear steps in Google AI Studio

slides.title: Securing Your API Key
slides.narration:
After generating your **API key**, it is crucial to secure it.
Copy it to a safe place.
Never share your **API key** publicly.
Think of it like your house keys.
You would not leave them lying around.
They grant access to your digital 'home'.
slides.image_prompt: Person at laptop, with an illustration of a lock and key securing digital data

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
Let us summarize what we learned.
We defined what **API keys** are.
We saw how to generate one in **Google AI Studio**.
We also discussed securing your **API key**.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
Now as an assignment,
generate an **API key** in **Google AI Studio**.
Store it securely for your projects.
Compare the results.
